episodes.title: The Nightmare Begins
episodes.summary: Vetri, an aspiring filmmaker who researched psycho killers for years, becomes a sub-inspector under family pressure. A 15-year-old girl is found murdered; he sees a serial killer at work, but his superiors refuse to listen.
episodes.cliffhanger: Vetri fears for his own niece Nila, a schoolgirl herself.

episodes.title: Who Is The Real Monster?
episodes.summary: Kumaresan, a teacher at Nila's school, is exposed as a predator and shot dead by Vetri while trying to escape. That night Nila is abducted from her birthday party and killed. Suspended, Vetri finds a piano tune on murdered girl Divya's hearing aid that leads to magician Stella Joseph, who performed at every victim's school.
episodes.cliffhanger: Stella Joseph is a fake name. Who is she really?

episodes.title: The Twist You Never Expected
episodes.summary: Retired officer Shanmugam reveals Stella Joseph is Grace Pereira, accused of murder years ago, whose son Daniel, a gifted pianist and magician, was mocked for a rare ageing disease. Grace died in an accident; Daniel kills disguised as her. He attacks Malar and kidnaps her niece Thendral; Vetri tracks him down, kills him after a brutal fight and rescues Thendral.
episodes.cliffhanger: The monster is dead and Thendral is safe.
